comments.text:
Unfortunately, Istanbul has also received a massive influx of migrants.
70–80% of the people you see on the streets are Kurds, Arabs,
Syrians, or from the East—
much like London or Paris.
The old Istanbul was more refined, elite, and tasteful.
Yet, despite this heavy migration and the rise of religious conservatives
(because the US wants to turn this place into another Afghanistan and exploit it),
the subways and streets remain more respectful toward women
than those in other Islamic countries.
Istanbul's unique geography has been buried under concrete.
Its skyline has been ruined.
Education and social graces have declined; the city has been overrun by uncouth people.
As someone born and raised in Istanbul, I see this clearly.😡😡
